Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Description: Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.335 (2026-11-07) [testing]
- **AoE heals no longer fire back to back on a party that is at or near full HP.** Follow-up to 1.0.4.334, same live report: "it's just generally using AOE healing more than it should. like.. multiple helios back to back when everyone is full". Recorded from the November 7 deep-dungeon session: nineteen Helios/Aspected Helios cast attempts in ten seconds while three of four members read 98-99% (bars that look full; regen-tick oscillation and display rounding) - the triggers had no notion of "near-full is full", and a heal that had just gone out did not stand the press path down while it landed. Two changes, shared by Astrologian, White Mage, Scholar and Sage. First, a member only counts as needing an AoE heal on a real deficit: a bar at or above 98% reads as full for both the one-button average and the auto-rotation's member count, so no threshold setting (including the 100 "disable this check" setting, and a target count of 0, which is now floored at 1) can make a full party eligible. Second, the auto-rotation presses one AoE heal at a time: after a press goes out, the next waits out that cast's flight plus a second for the heal to land and party HP to propagate, so a movement-cancelled cast is no longer re-issued every tick. Real damage is never starved - a party still under the threshold after the window heals again immediately. Single-target heals, raidwide pre-casts and the 1.0.4.334 out-of-range fix are unchanged; the manual one-button still heals when pressed.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.334 (2026-11-07) [testing]
- **Healer one-button AoE heals no longer trigger off party members the heal cannot reach.** The Astrologian, White Mage, Scholar and Sage one-button AoE heal rotations averaged the whole party's HP: a member standing outside the heal's radius kept the average under the threshold, so the rotation kept choosing AoE heals (Helios, Medica, Succor, Prognosis and their oGCD neighbours) that could never heal that member - reported live as Astrologian repeatedly casting AoE heals whenever someone was out of range. The trigger now averages only the members inside the heal's own effect radius (15y for the Helios family), alive and targetable, so the rotation returns to damaging while nobody reachable needs healing, and heals again the moment the far member comes back into range. Single-target healing is untouched: a member returning to range is picked up by the single-target path exactly as before. Raidwide pre-casts and the auto-rotation's own cast gate are unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.333 (2026-11-06) [testing]
- **The movement recorder and the shadow move planner actually start now.** Every load of 1.0.4.328-1.0.4.332 killed them at startup: the tap installed itself before the settings existed and died on an error the moment the plugin loaded, so your November 5 session recorded no movement at all and nothing reached the movement database. The tap now installs after the settings load, the settings read can no longer fail that way, and if an install ever fails again it retries on the framework tick and on every zone change (a login is one) instead of staying dead for the whole session.
- **The movement relay address can no longer be lost to a blank setting.** A blank relay address now falls back to the shared LAN Jev relay (http://192.168.10.44:8797), so recorded movement reaches the database without anyone typing /gluttony movelog relay first; the command still overrides the address. Before this build a blank address silently switched the uploads off.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Log only: nothing moves the character, nothing presses a button, never in PvP, off under AutoDuty. 1.0.4.328-1.0.4.332 collected no movement samples; this is the first build that can.

v1.0.4.332 (2026-11-05) [testing]
- **A party-callout reader that joins chat words to the live fight state, log only (Jev Fight Brain).** While in combat inside a duty, short party and alliance chat lines from party members are read and joined to the exact state the plugin already sees: the head-marker signs each member carries, who is tethered, where the members stand relative to the player, the Fight Brain forecast's next mechanic with its countdown, how long ago the last mechanic resolved, and who said the line. The code builds a few candidate responses from that state first (one marker means that player; two markers mean the player's own light party's marker under the role-split arrangement; no marker with a stack forecast within six seconds means pre-position; no marker and nothing soon means the line is stale and nothing moves; a telegraph under the player outranks every callout) and computes the code's own answer. The LAN Jev relay is then asked one choice question in its own "callout" mode with its own daily cap: which candidate the words mean - "stack on me", "middle", "with H2", "LB now", "rez" and "go left" all land in the same candidate space, and lines no rule can name are not asked at all. One `FB|callout` line records the text, the state and the code answer; one `FB|callout-pick` line records Jev's pick beside it; one `FB|callout-outcome` line about eight seconds later records party deaths and HP drops since the ask, with both picks repeated. The conflict order is printed in every line: safety rules first, then the live callout, then the pre-pull plan. Nothing here presses an action, moves anyone or changes a target: the rotation is untouched, and the reader stays off under AutoDuty or any other external rotation driver, never in PvP, never in a Crucible board. The placed waymark signs on the map are not read; the state comes from the head markers, tethers, positions and forecast.
- **A "Callout Reader (Jev)" switch in the Fight Brain (log-only) section of the Auto-Rotation tab**, beside "Plan Reader (Jev)" and "Party Shadow", default on, sharing the same relay URL which still switches all shadow questions off when cleared. It gates log lines and shadow asks only.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.331 (2026-11-05) [testing]
- **The movement relay URL's command is named correctly now.** 1.0.4.330's note and two in-game help texts said the movement relay URL is set with "/gluttony moverelay"; no such command exists - the real form is "/gluttony movelog relay <url>" (and "/gluttony movelog" alone still toggles the recorder, the planner and the Jev questions together). The note and both help texts name the real command now. Text-only fix: nothing the plugin reads, logs, presses or moves changes.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.330 (2026-11-05) [testing]
- **The Fight Brain switches promised in 1.0.4.329 are real now.** That release's notes advertised "Plan Reader (Jev)" and "Party Shadow" switches, but the build shipped without them: the two toggles existed only as config fields the code read. They are checkboxes in the settings window now, in the Fight Brain (log-only) section of the Auto-Rotation tab, beside the countdown-strip switch. "Plan Reader (Jev)" switches the pre-pull plan reader on and off; "Party Shadow" switches the party-data shadow lines on and off - the FB|party-mit mitigation tally and the FB|pos-zone position lines, which until now ran whenever the Fight Brain itself ran; the switch now governs both, as its description always said. Both default on and share the existing Fight Brain relay URL, which still switches all shadow questions off when cleared. The switches gate log lines and shadow asks only - nothing about what the rotation presses or how anything moves changes.
- **The movement switches show their real names.** 1.0.4.328's notes promised "Movement Recorder", "Movement Planner (shadow)" and "Movement Jev Questions" switches in the settings window's Rotation Behavior section; the switches have been rendered there since, but under their raw internal field names (MovementRecorderOn_Name and friends), because their labels were never localized. The labels exist now, so the three switches show under the promised names, each with its own help text; all default on. One part of the 1.0.4.328 note stays a command: the movement relay URL has no settings-window input (the settings tab renders toggles and numbers only), so it remains /gluttony movelog relay <url>, and /gluttony movelog remains the quick switch for all three.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.
